description.value: Pepper Creek is a family-owned pizza and pasta shop on BC's Sunshine Coast, run by owners Mike and Tami who together bring over fifty years of restaurant experience. All dough and sauces are hand-made daily in-house from scratch, with no nuts, MSG, or chemical preservatives. The shop offers dine-in, takeout, local delivery up to 13 km in each direction, and a Take'n Bake line of ready-to-bake pizzas.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms an active pizza and pasta restaurant on the Sunshine Coast. OSM tags (takeaway=yes, delivery=yes) are corroborated by the website's Take'n Bake and delivery pages. The website explicitly mentions vegan cheese and gluten-free ingredients, confirming dietary options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name is 'Pepper Creek' but the business consistently presents itself as 'Pepper Creek Pizza and Pasta' or 'Pepper Creek Pizza & Pasta' on its website.
Website lists a second phone number (604 885 4244) not present in OSM.
OSM community field says 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but the business is on the Sunshine Coast (near Sechelt), which is a separate region — may be a community classification error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible restaurant on a major cycling route (Sunshine Coast Highway) with confirmed takeout and delivery, suitable as a food stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states: 'We also carry a completely vegan cheese for those who don't do dairy' and 'Our wheat-based pizza dough and its ingredients are produced and stored in a different facility from the gluten-free ingredients.'

wow_evidence: family-owned pizza and pasta shop... all dough and sauces are hand-made daily in-house from scratch
